_why: The reference trade pack. It exists to prove the model end-to-end — conditional questions, a depth-1 follow-up, chips that are answers, and a first question that settles the exact NCO code without a disambiguation prompt listing 44 welding titles.
_first_question: welding_process IS the disambiguator. Retrieval pins the FAMILY (7212); this question decides between 'Welder, Gas' and 'Welder, Electric' deterministically, for free, in the worker's own vocabulary. That is the whole reason packs are bound to families instead of occupations.
review_note: Authored as the Phase 4 reference pack. Reviewer of record is git blame.

items.why_text: Har welding alag hoti hai, isse sahi naukri milti hai.
items.retry_text: Gas, arc, MIG ya TIG mein se kaunsi?

items.prompt_text: Kya aap overhead welding kar lete hain?
items.why_text: Overhead welding ka alag rate milta hai.

items.prompt_text: Aap kaunse material par kaam karte hain?
items.why_text: Steel aur aluminium ka kaam alag hota hai.

items.prompt_text: Kya aapne safety training li hai?
items.why_text: Factory wale safety training wale ko pehle rakhte hain.

items.prompt_text: Aap factory mein kaam karte hain ya site par?
items.why_text: Factory aur site ka kaam alag hota hai.

items.prompt_text: Kya aapke paas welding ka certificate hai?
items.why_text: Certificate se behtar vetan milta hai.
